title: DeadlyDebts
description: The ultimate physical-item bounty system for Minecraft servers.
body:
# 💰 DeadlyDebts: Physical Item Bounty System
Stop rewarding killers with virtual numbers. Start rewarding them with cold, hard loot.

DeadlyDebts is a premium-grade bounty plugin for 1.21.x servers that shifts the focus from "infinite" virtual currency to a physical economy. Whether you're running a Hardcore Factions server, a competitive SMP, or a Lifesteal world, DeadlyDebts provides a secure and exciting way for players to put hits out on their rivals.

# ✨ Why choose DeadlyDebts?
Many bounty plugins are prone to exploits like item ghosting or bypassing limits. DeadlyDebts was built with a focus on absolute data integrity and server stability.

**Physical Staking:** Players must actually own the items (Diamonds, Netherite, etc.) to place a bounty. If you want someone dead, you have to pay the price from your own inventory.

**Atomic Security & Race-Condition Protection:** We use advanced thread synchronization to ensure that even if multiple players try to "spam" items into a bounty at the same time, the slot limits are strictly enforced.

**Zero-Lag Performance:** By utilizing asynchronous I/O and intelligent memory caching, the plugin ensures that GUI interactions are instant and never hitch your server's TPS.

**Anti-Ghosting Logic:** No more "ghost items" stuck in menus. Our custom inventory sync forces the client and server to stay perfectly aligned, providing a smooth and reliable user experience.

**Loot Previews:** Hunters can browse active bounties and see exactly what items they will receive upon a successful kill.

# 🛠️ Administrative Control
The plugin includes a robust confirmation system for admins. Removing a bounty isn't just a command, it opens a dedicated Admin Confirmation GUI to prevent accidental deletions of valuable player items.

# ⚙️ Easy Configuration
You have total control over what counts as "currency." Define your own allowed-bounty-items list in the config. Perfect for servers using custom currencies, rare materials, or even standard ores.
